name: Edinburgh
pointBasis: UN WUP2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: A public RoS INSPIRE WMS GetFeatureInfo request at a 101×101 pixel scale returned the full native MultiPolygon with INSPIRE id gb.ros.lr.SCT0009110317. Its geometry lies about 2.507 m from the unchanged WUP point and does not contain that point. A separate 1×1 sub-meter pixel centered at the exact WUP point returned zero features. One nearby polygon is retained as bounded local evidence; this is not a point hit or citywide coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official Midlothian county archive was retrieved anonymously and audited in native EPSG:27700. All 3148 bounding-box candidates were valid; 2222 full polygons intersect the 1 km WUP-centered circle. The exact locator has no covering polygon; the nearest same-ID source feature is about 2.96 m away. The local index contains 1709 positive-area overlap pairs, including 1259 of at least 1 m² and a maximum 14313.205 m². RoS explicitly permits overlapping and stacked polygons in this index model. The source is valid in that model, but is incompatible with exclusive 2D ground-parcel rendering until those source semantics are represented. No geometry repair, removal or substitution was used.
